flashside.name: Flashside
message.flashside.installCloth: Install Cloth Config API to access mod options
option.flashside.common.leftSide.tooltip: Whether to place the Flashside buttons on the left, instead of the right.
option.flashside.common.modmenuIconTop.t: Whether to place the ModMenu button above the Flashside buttons.
option.flashside.pause.startRow.tooltip: Where the Flashside buttons will start (0 for the top row).
option.flashside.pause.commandEnabled.to: Whether to show an additional button for a custom command.
option.flashside.pause.commandString.too: The command to send when the command button is pressed.
option.flashside.title: Title Screen
option.flashside.title.editTitleScreen.t: Whether to allow repositioning the Flashback button on the title screen.
This feature is provided as-is and NOT supported, if it conflicts with your other mods do not use it.
option.flashside.title.startRowTitleScre: Where the Flashside buttons will start (0 for the top row).
